subject: Invoice sender & AP handoff: portal onboarding + email copy preference
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Andrea Miller <ap@acme-logistics.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 08:13:00 -0400
Subject: Invoice sender & AP handoff: portal onboarding + email copy preference

Hi Andrea,

Thanks again for the call this morning. To summarize our preferred handoff path and confirm next steps so we can get you on the portal without disrupting AP today:

- Invoice creation: Redwood will generate monthly PDF invoices from invoice@redwoodinference.com.
- Primary delivery: NovusPay (portal) push for structured e-invoice and archived PDFs.
- Email copy: Per your ask, we can also CC ap@acme-logistics.com for the first three billing cycles while your team finalizes the portal ingest.
- VAT/evidence: Please confirm the VAT number and EORI (if applicable) for your EU entity so we can include the right tax fields on the invoice.

I've attached a sample invoice template for formatting checks (sample_invoice_template.pdf). Connor is cc'd to kick off the portal onboarding and share the onboarding guide.

Next steps: Could you confirm the AP email to receive copies and the VAT/EORI by end of day tomorrow? We'll schedule the portal invite once we have the AP contact.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0148

Attachment: sample_invoice_template.pdf (PDF, 47KB)

From: Andrea Miller <ap@acme-logistics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 13:02:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Invoice sender & AP handoff: portal onboarding + email copy preference

Hi Marissa,

Appreciate the clear recap. A couple quick confirmations from AP:

- Please send copies to ap-payables@acme-logistics.com (this mailbox is monitored by two people).
- We'll accept portal-pushed e-invoices as canonical once NovusPay mapping is validated; email copies needed for the first 2 months while we validate the mapping rules.
- VAT number: ACME-EU-45321. EORI: GB123456789000 (we're EU-headquartered but do cross-border shipments).

Can you confirm whether the portal will send an invoice webhook / webhook payload (JSON) or just a PDF object? We need the invoice_lines and PO number parsed for our AP automation.

Thanks,
Andrea Miller
Head of AP Operations
Acme Logistics
ap@acme-logistics.com

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Andrea Miller <ap@acme-logistics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice sender & AP handoff: portal onboarding + email copy preference

Hi Andrea — copying the implementation details you asked for.

Short answers up front:
- Portal delivery: NovusPay will push both the structured payload (JSON / UBL-like fields) and a PDF for archival. The payload will include invoice_lines, currency, totals, tax_breakdown, and a PO number field when provided.
- Webhook: We can register your AP endpoint to receive webhooks; if you prefer SFTP push instead we support that as well.

Practical onboarding steps (what I'll do):
1) Send portal invite to ap-payables@acme-logistics.com and create a test invoice mapping with "ACME-EU-45321" so you can validate pre-production mapping.
2) Share the portal mapping doc and sample payloads — see portal-onboarding-guide.pdf attached.
3) Turn on email-copy CC to ap-payables@acme-logistics.com for the first 2 cycles per your request; we'll automatically stop the copies after verification unless you ask us to keep them.

Kimberly, can you confirm the sender address we'll use for PDF/email? We currently use invoice@redwoodinference.com but can route from a delegated alias if that helps with PO matching.

Connor O'Brien
Implementation Lead, Finance Integrations
Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai

Attachment: portal-onboarding-guide.pdf (PDF, 220KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Andrea Miller <ap@acme-logistics.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 15:27:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice sender & AP handoff: portal onboarding + email copy preference

Thanks team — confirming final routing: 

- Invoice sender: invoice@redwoodinference.com (canonical). We'll also add a Reply-To of billing@redwoodinference.com so it lands in your AP triage if someone replies.
- Email copy: Enable CC to ap-payables@acme-logistics.com for invoice dates 2026-10-31 and 2026-11-30 (two cycles) while mapping is validated.
- Portal: Connor to create test mapping for ACME-EU-45321 and share sample webhook payloads; Andrea to confirm mapping acceptance.
- VAT/EORI: confirmed and will be embedded on line-level tax fields.

Andrea — we'll send the portal invite today and a test payload. If you want us to keep email copies after validation, just reply-all and we'll make that permanent.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
